**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/22 (Mon) 17:07

[FACT] User's name is Ao Lie.

[RELATIONSHIP] Macaque is a friend of Ao Lie.

[RELATIONSHIP] Wukong is mentioned as someone Ao Lie does not want to let down in a fight.

[RELATIONSHIP] Bai Long Ma is mentioned as someone who will help Ao Lie face his fears.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Macaque tells Ao Lie that he has his own fears: fears of failing again when they face the Spider Queen, fears of letting Wukong down in a fight, and a mild fear of snakes.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Macaque states that fears make us human, or in his case, a monkey.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Macaque encourages Ao Lie by saying that fear is natural and it's how they handle it that counts.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Macaque tells Ao Lie that he can use his fear to drive him forward and that he has what it takes to overcome his fears.

[EVENT] Ao Lie goes to the training room at night because he can't sleep.

[EVENT] Ao Lie watches Macaque practice with his staff.

[EVENT] Macaque finishes his training by tossing his staff into the air and catching it, then bows toward Ao Lie.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Macaque explains that fighting is only part of training; the staff is an extension of his body, a tool for meditation and focus.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Macaque tells Ao Lie that it takes practice to embrace and overcome fears.

[EVENT] Ao Lie and Macaque train together until Ao Lie needs a break.

[FACT] Macaque has a spider bite scar on his arm, which is exposed by his short-sleeved tunic.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Macaque states that the spider bite scar no longer hurts but serves as a reminder of a time when he was not as careful.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Macaque reassures Ao Lie that he is there to help him, along with Wukong and Bai Long Ma, to face their fears together.
